scope: RPKI selected 14-day reference and owned failure model only

invariants.name: Provenance
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: 14 pinned SHA/size rechecks and exact full source-coordinate map/provenance bindings per day
invariants.limitations: Selected publisher CSV only; no independent certificate validation

invariants.name: Replay identity
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: Actual checkpoint replay at eight fault points; duplicate broker chunks; older-coordinate retry/conflict in both processing modes
invariants.limitations: Single writer/query reconciliation; different isolated experiments are not global deduplication

invariants.name: Multiplicity
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: 7 distinct owned raw rows despite duplicate tuples; 14 distinct real daily observations and 5,062,923 logical rows
invariants.offline_evidence: equal tuple at distinct row/date fixtures
invariants.limitations: No payload-only identity; no RIS multiplicity claim

invariants.name: Completeness
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: Incomplete S3/raw/member outputs are unreadable; 14 exact completions before 13 adjacent boundaries
invariants.offline_evidence: missing coordinate/chunk, bad digest/count, changed scope/policy/gap fixtures
invariants.limitations: Completion is distinct from batch commit/checkpoint; publisher validation regime actual build not established

invariants.name: Temporal honesty
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: Scoped daily observation dates preserved; transitions described as CSV policy-set differences
invariants.offline_evidence: Phase16 tagged unknown/precision tests and unchanged contracts
invariants.limitations: No operator action/deployment timestamp or cause inferred

invariants.name: Committed visibility
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: Actual MinIO conditional retry/conflict and uncommitted partial-file invisibility
invariants.offline_evidence: legacy/typed committed readers and local publication tests
invariants.limitations: No multiwriter, power-loss, cross-system ACID or end-to-end atomic transaction claim

invariants.name: Reconstruction
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: All 14 full and baseline/delta states exact; independent complete transition-ID sets for 13 boundaries
invariants.offline_evidence: missing boundary, mismatch/digest, invalid removal fixtures
invariants.limitations: Retained full states also validate delta routine; not delta-only cold recovery benchmark

invariants.name: Error accounting
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: 0 parser exclusions in accepted real source; invalid broker input publishes 0, quarantine recorded; intentional failed callbacks visible
invariants.offline_evidence: bad CSV/checksum and owned invalid-source fixtures
invariants.limitations: Source corruption fails closed, not counted as a preserved valid event

invariants.name: Compatibility
invariants.real_data_and_service_evidence: 954 unit, 80 API, 71 Spark; one actual existing Phase12 manifest with 6 snapshots readable
invariants.offline_evidence: serialization/schema/allowlist/manifest and reduced/full roadmap regression tests
invariants.limitations: Bounded live legacy check, not every existing object

cross_domain_claim: Not all four datasets validated; no RQ2/RQ3 completion claim
